race.title: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Handicap
race.verdict: A wide-open sprint handicap with the narrow vote in favour of KING'S CROWN . He needs to dispel a lesser effort here 3 weeks ago but tasted success twice from much higher marks over C&D last winter and this is his easiest assignment for some time. Dc Cogent is another to note on the back of a short break, with Woolridge and Shatin Venture completing the shortlist. KING'S CROWN (IRE) DC COGENT WOOLRIDGE
race.bettingForecast: Shatin Venture (5/1), Dc Cogent (6/1), Golden Havana (7/1), Henery Hawk (7/1), Wrestling Revenue (8/1), Crypto Quest (8/1), Auntie Jo (10/1), South Shore Island (10/1), King's Crown (14/1), Until Dawn (14/1), Woolridge (16/1), Powernap (16/1), Delagate This Lord (25/1), Thank The Lord (33/1)
